title: Add SRD background representation and import Acolyte
description:
Problem
The SRD contains background content, including Acolyte, but the current record model does not appear to represent backgrounds as first-class records.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
Unrepresented source content includes:
- Backgrounds
- Acolyte background
- Background characteristics/proficiencies/equipment/features as applicable

Required behavior
- Add a background record kind or otherwise explicit representation for SRD backgrounds.
- Import Acolyte with complete source-derived fields and provenance.
- Preserve background feature/proficiency/equipment text in structured form where feasible.

IMPORTER SAFETY
Importer safety: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not weaken regression tests or audit expectations to match current generated output; fix parser/extractor behavior or document source-backed evidence that the expectation was wrong.
close_reason: Merged in PR #191 (squash): background:acolyte record, 4 Acolyte characteristics roll tables, 6 Backgrounds chapter-intro rules; pack 1637->1648.
